title: SpaceX President Shotwell Files to Sell $52M in Shares Under 10b5-1 Plan
detail: SpaceX President and COO Gwynne Shotwell filed a Form 144 with the SEC on September 22, 2026 disclosing plans to sell 342,170 shares of SPCX common stock — worth approximately $51.96 million at the ~$151.85 reference price — through Morgan Stanley Smith Barney. The proposed sale, Shotwell's first insider sale in three months, falls under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan she adopted June 23, 2026 covering up to 585,605 shares; this tranche represents about 58% of that authorization. The shares were to be acquired via stock option exercise on the same day as the sale. SPCX traded roughly flat to slightly lower overnight following the filing.

media.caption: SpaceX President and COO Gwynne Shotwell filed to sell $52M in SPCX shares under a pre-arranged trading plan
